guidance_context.retrieval_question_text: Private employee ako. My employer has not paid my wages. What wage-payment rules apply?

claims.text: The recorded provision states that wages must be paid at least once every two weeks or twice a month, which means the interval between payments cannot exceed sixteen days, unless a force majeure event or circumstances beyond the employer’s control prevent regular payment, in which case the employer must pay immediately after such event ends. If wages are paid by check, the payment method is allowed only when it is customary, stipulated in a collective agreement, or when all of the following conditions are met: a bank or cash‑out facility within one kilometer of the workplace, no pecuniary benefit to the employer, reasonable time for employees to withdraw during banking hours (counted as compensable work time), and written consent of the employees if no collective agreement exists.

citations.citation_display: Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code, SECTION 3
citations.quote: Time of payment. — (a) Wages shall be paid not less than once every two (2) weeks or twice a month at intervals not exceeding sixteen (16) days, unless payment cannot be made with such regularity due to force majeure or circumstances beyond the employer's control in which case the employer shall pay the wages immediately after such force majeure or circumstances have ceased.
citations.citation_label: Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code, SECTION 3 — BOOK THREE, CHAPTER IV, RULE VIII

citations.citation_display: Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code, SECTION 2
citations.quote: Payment by check. — Payment of wages by bank checks, postal checks or money orders is allowed where such manner of wage payment is customary on the date of the effectivity of the Code, where it is so stipulated in a collective agreement, or where all of the following conditions are met:
citations.citation_label: Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code, SECTION 2 — BOOK THREE, CHAPTER IV, RULE VIII

citations.citation_display: Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code, SECTION 2
citations.quote: (a) There is a bank or other facility for encashment within a radius of one (1) kilometer from the workplace;
citations.citation_label: Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code, SECTION 2 — BOOK THREE, CHAPTER IV, RULE VIII
